questions.qtext: Which one of the following failure theory gives good predictions for brittle material when subjected to several types of loads simultaneously?
questions.solution:
(a)
Experimental investigations suggest that the maximum principal stress theory (i.e. Rankine’s theory) gives good predictions for brittle materials as they are weak in tension. However, it is not recommended for ductile materials.

questions.qtext: Which of the following statement(s) is/are correct regarding disk brakes?

options.text: It becomes self-locking due to wear, if not properly disigned.
The brake is equally effective for both directions of rotation of the disk.
The braking torque is linearly proportional to the actuating force.
There is no mechanical fade of friction lining.

questions.solution:
(b, c, d )
The disk brakes have following advantages:
1. Disk brake is simple to install and service.
2. Disk. brake has high torque transmitting capacity in small volume.
3. In drum brakes, as the temperature increases, the coefficient of friction decreases. Due to inherent ability of disk brake to dissipate heat, it is insensitive to changes in coefficient of friction. There is no, mechanical ‘fade’ of friction lining. Fading is the loss of torque
transmitting capacity of friction lining at higher temperatures.
4. The disk brake is easy to control.
5. The brake can never become self-locking.
6. The brake is equally effective for both directions of rotation of the disk.
7. The disk brake has ‘linearity’, that is, the braking torque is linearly proportional to the actuating force.
